title: Benchmark KRN delivery against a plain harness
body:
Operator 2026-10-27 (ADR 0014 D23): a two-week proof of full KRN delivery against a plain harness (Codex alone, human merge), plus a market review of comparable tools, measured by operator minutes per merge, lead time p50/p90, review rounds and noise, escaped defects and cost per PR. It uses the delivery records from t-ste3f73 and runs in parallel with FR-40.
Acceptance: a pre-registered comparison with raw per-task results and a stated win or loss per metric.
